_comment: Percentages the Tribunal administratif du logement publishes each January, by the start date of the renewed lease. Add a row each year (the 2027 row comes out in January 2027). Until a period's row exists, the calculator uses the latest row and marks the result as provisional.

periods.method: Règlement sur les critères de fixation de loyer, as amended by décret 1455-2025 (in force 2026-01-01)
